headline: Short-term rentals | Constitutional Court rejects Emilia-Romagna's rules, but the goal of limiting overtourism is right
summary: The Constitutional Court declared illegitimate Emilia-Romagna's restrictions on short-term rentals introduced to counter overtourism, in ruling number 164.
why: Rules on short-term rentals affect platform operators and the supply of residential property used for tourism accommodation in Italy.
